public_sources: Piray & Daw 2024 Nature Communications volatility/stochasticity paper
Aravkin et al. Student-t robust/trend state-space work

actions: Calibrated a fixed posterior-predictive residual-family checker with Student-t, skew, time-gap-aware correlation and scale alternatives on disjoint matched Gaussian streams.
Tested action-dependent partial-observation correlated-burst misspecification and threshold sensitivity.
Implemented an explicit generative correlated-observation family crossed with four volatility/stochasticity source states and marginalized semantic source identity over observation family.
Ran held-out paired matched-Gaussian and correlated-burst audits and bootstrap comparisons.
Persisted immutable neuroscience delta and advanced role-local LATEST via CAS.

result_summary.fixed_residual_checker: Did not eliminate confident semantic reversals under correlated bursts; post-hoc anomaly threshold is not a valid identifiability certificate.
result_summary.explicit_correlated_family: Reduced correlated-burst confident semantic reversal rate from 3.03% to 1.64% in held-out 80-seed audit, but did not reach the near-zero safety target and did not resolve regret improvement over shared/base.
result_summary.next_design: Joint semantic-invariance posterior across Gaussian, heavy-tail, skewed and correlated/burst observation families; source-specific control only when all plausible families agree.

exact_next_action: Cross source states with explicit iid Gaussian, Student-t, skewed and correlated/burst observation families, marginalize nuisance parameters online, and gate on semantic agreement across plausible families. Test held-out t3/heavy-tail, unseen skew, bursts, scale drift and mixtures before any dormant-memory connection.
